description: Identity fields (toolCallId, toolIndex, name) are carried once on tool_call_start and never repeated on continuation deltas - only callRef.sourceKey is - matching how a real provider adapter emits these once it has resolved identity. Correlation must work from sourceKey alone.

provenance.note: Generalizes the class of bug filed and fixed upstream: an id-less continuation fragment must still correlate to the right call, never fall back to array-position or get dropped.
